QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_22

question.text: The SEBI Stewardship Code applicable to AIFs on their LISTED investee exposures is built around HOW MANY guiding principles?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI's Stewardship Code for AIFs (and Mutual Funds) lays down SIX principles covering: (1) stewardship policy formulation, (2) conflicts of interest, (3) monitoring investees, (4) intervention policy, (5) voting disclosure, (6) periodic stewardship reporting. The Trap: 4 / 5 / 8 are distractors. 5 is especially tempting (matches UK Stewardship Code versions) but SEBI's Indian version has six. Cross-Exam Context: XV (Research Analyst) and XXI-B (PM) test stewardship principles on listed portfolios. XIX-C focuses on AIFs' specific obligation to apply them to LISTED investee holdings. Manager's Pro-Tip: Publish a one-page stewardship policy on the fund's website and review annually. A SEBI inspection absent a stewardship policy for an AIF with even one listed company is an immediate finding.
